params.caption: 🖥️ Jensen Huang: I'd be honored to return as Nvidia CEO In his first public statement since resigning, Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang told The Wall Street Journal he has seen the wave of calls from employees, investors, partners and customers to bring him back.
